name: people
description: Per-person notes under spice/people/<First Last>.md, with hub at spice/people/People.md and shared rendering via people-rendering mechanism. Materializes Templater folder template + global People nav-button. v0.2.0: migrated NewPersonButton dataviewjs helper to entity-create@0.1.0 declarative new_entity_buttons[] with safe-filename validate predicate; scripts/new-person-button.js deleted. v0.2.0 follow-up: removed body_template (Template, People.md Templater syntax + own-frontmatter block incompatible with entity-create); frontmatter_template carries the static-known person fields (company/location/title/email/website/aliases/phone/tags); inline_body carries the PersonNavButtons + PeopleRendering mention-list dataviewjs blocks. Legacy auto-move directive is redundant because entity-create's destination already writes the file at spice/people/<name>.md. v0.2.1 PATCH (v0.47.0): added "type": "person" to new_entity_buttons[0].frontmatter_template. Fixes BUG-2 from headspace Phase 3 (person notes created via the + New Person button were missing the type frontmatter; type-filtered People hub queries skipped them). v0.47.0 also lands a validator Layer 2 type-field convention rule (forward-defense) to prevent this omission from recurring in future blueprints. v0.4.0 MINOR (v0.61.0 FA-8): depends_on backlink-panel >=0.1.0; Template, People.md + new_entity_buttons[0].inline_body grow ## Mentions H2 below the existing Daily Mentions block — universal cross-blueprint backlink panel via canonical people: cross-ref reverse query (additive to PeopleRendering's scoped meetings/daily panels). v0.5.0 MINOR (v0.88.0 people-cohesion-1): removed templater_folder_templates[] entry binding spice/people/ → Template, People.md. Entity-create button is now the only canonical creation path; Template, People.md stays in files[] for manual Insert template workflows. Eliminates the entity-create vs Templater double-fire bug that produced double-frontmatter / templater-error person notes (diagnosed at v0.88.0 S0). naming_pattern relaxed from ^[A-Z][a-zA-Z'\- ]+ [A-Z][a-zA-Z'\- ]+\.md$ to ^[A-ZÀ-Ý][A-Za-zÀ-ÿ''\.\- ]*\.md$ — accepts mononyms (Madonna), diacritics (Élise Martin), multi-part names (John Paul Smith), honorifics (Dr. Strange), and curly apostrophes (O'Brien). v0.5.1 PATCH (v0.88.1): PersonNavButtons script no longer passes icon: null to customJS.AccentButton.render — instead passes a real left-arrow SVG (Lucide arrow-left) for the back-button. Label drops the redundant '←' character. Closes the cosmetic regression where the back-button rendered as literal 'null ← Back to People' on every person note (the bug surfaced as soon as v0.88.0 unblocked the PersonNavButtons render path; pre-v0.88.0 person notes were too broken for the dataviewjs block to execute). Tracks lockstep with accent-button@0.1.1's null-guard. v0.5.2 PATCH (v0.88.2): declares removed_templater_folder_templates: ["spice/people"] so the installer purges the v0.4.0-era stale Templater folder-template binding from each consumer vault's .obsidian/plugins/templater-obsidian/data.json. Closes the additive-install gap surfaced when v0.88.0 removed the binding from the people manifest but every previously-installed consumer vault still had the entry in its local Templater config — causing the entity-create-vs-Templater double-fire bug to PERSIST on new person creation even after v0.88.0/v0.88.1 deploys. Requires install.js v0.88.2 applyTemplaterFolderTemplateRemovals helper (called BEFORE applyTemplaterFolderTemplates in installItem). Idempotent: once removed, re-running is a no-op. FLN-v88-7. v0.6.0 MINOR (v0.89.0 people-cohesion-2): introduces typed-alias schema convention for aliases:[] — entries may be {type, value} objects (canonical) or bare strings (back-compat, treated as implicit name-type). Recommended types: phone, email, name, handle. Adds depends_on people-identity ≥0.1.0 (new mechanism shipping the in-Obsidian customjs resolver consuming this schema). Rule_fragment fragment gains an aliases_schema documentation block (validator-readable, not validator-enforced this cycle). No migration of existing bare-string aliases; back-compat path normalizes them at read time. No naming_pattern change (v0.88.0 relaxation stands). v0.6.1 PATCH (v0.126.1 PeopleRendering args fix): both new_entity_buttons[0].inline_body AND templates/Template, People.md had `args: [dv, {mode...}, {style}]` on every PeopleRendering.renderMentionList invocation (Meetings + Daily Mentions panels) but customjs-guard already prepends dv → method received (dv, dv, {query}, {opts}) → query bound to second dv → 'unknown mode undefined' Notice fired twice on every person-note render. Pre-existing since v0.88.0 PeopleRendering pilot. Drop the leading dv from args in all four invocations (two in inline_body, two in template). Lockstep with meetings@0.11.1 same-bug fix.

new_entity_buttons.label: + New Person

post_install.message: people@0.1.0 installed. Open spice/people/People.md to see the hub. Click '+ New Person' to create. Existing People notes (if migrated from a consumer vault) survive as long as they live under spice/people/.
